items.statement: The submitted calculation verifies the supplied 6a identity and validates optimized gas and chloroform structures as local minima.
items.expected: Explicit atom/charge/multiplicity check plus frequency or justified minimum evidence for both environments.

items.statement: The chloroform frontier-orbital gap is reported and compared to the optical gap.
items.expected: A signed HOMO, LUMO, derived gap and absolute deviation are reported with units and provenance.
